Leave wide clear crew paths. Hull bottom and all sea creatures sit IN the water: overlapping foam, dark submerged band, broken reflections, no dry cutout hovering above waves. Small friendly slate-blue suggestion shark half-submerged near lower left with only head/back/fin above ripples and a tiny three-dot speech marker.
